title: Mock domain claim
description: Extends frame-claim-v1 with the one thing this fixture field must freeze. A real pack freezes whatever would, if it changed silently, make a result stop meaning what it claimed.

expected_value.description: The value the artifact must normalize to for the exact tier to pass.

normalization.description: How artifact content is normalized before comparison. Frozen because changing it after a failure would silently redefine what passing means.

sample_size.description: Entries checked by the sampled tier. Frozen so a failing run cannot be rescued by quietly checking less.
